Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in East Kotawaringin Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and human dignity, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.
Thus far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and children victims of violence have not yet regulated protection measures at the Regional level, therefore institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection measures for victims, particularly with regard to prevention, services and empowerment of women and children victims of violence in East Kotawaringin Regency.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL
PROVISIONS
Article In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:
1. Region is East Kotawaringin Regency
2. Regional Government is the Regional Government of East Kotawaringin Regency
3. Regent is the Regent of East Kotawaringin
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of East Kotawaringin Regency
5. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age, including a child still in the womb.
6. Woman is a person who is female in gender.
7. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological to the victim.
8. Violence against women is any action that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or private life.
9. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, neglect, exploitation, and other violence.
10. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of East Kotawaringin Regency.
11. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the Regional Government, police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear about what will or has occurred in violence against women.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing about, during or after the occurrence of violence against victims.
14. Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has expertise in accompanying victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
15. Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a functional work unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence.
16. Safe House is a shelter for victims, during the accompaniment process, for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and danger of perpetrators.
17. Standard Operating Procedure hereinafter abbreviated as SOP is standard steps that must be taken in protecting victims starting from complaint/identification, rehabilitation, health, social rehabilitation, legal services up to repatriation and social reintegration of witnesses and/or victims.
18. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
19. Household is husband, wife, and children, people who have family relationships due to blood relations, marriage, breastfeeding, care, and representation, and/or domestic workers and reside in that household.
20. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget hereinafter abbreviated as APBD is the Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget of East Kotawaringin Regency
21. Coordination Forum for Protection of Victims of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FKPKK is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner.
22. Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and children hereinafter abbreviated as PPTPPA is a community-based institution whose members are multistakeholder observers of women and children at the government and non-government levels.

CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in East Kotawaringin Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and human dignity, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.
Thus far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and children victims of violence have not yet regulated protection measures at the Regional level, therefore institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection measures for victims, particularly with regard to prevention, services and empowerment of women and children victims of violence in East Kotawaringin Regency.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in East Kotawaringin Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and human dignity, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.
Thus far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and children victims of violence have not yet regulated protection measures at the Regional level, therefore institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection measures for victims, particularly with regard to prevention, services and empowerment of women and children victims of violence in East Kotawaringin Regency.
